cards.text: Jacob, Isaac's son, has been living with his father-in-law Laban and shepherding Laban's flocks (Genesis 30:31). Now word gets back to Jacob about what Laban's sons are saying about him. And friend, it is NOT a thank-you card.

cards.question: What are Laban's sons saying about Jacob?

answers.text: He built all his wealth off their father
He spends too little time with the flocks
He still owes their father a year of work

cards.question: Jacob can see on Laban's face that Laban's attitude toward him has changed.

cards.text: And then, friend, Jacob hears from Somebody whose opinion actually MATTERS. The LORD speaks to Jacob.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell Jacob to do?

answers.text: Go back to the land of his fathers
Stay and make peace with Laban's sons
Take all his flocks down into Egypt

cards.question: Along with that command, the LORD promises Jacob that He will be with him.

cards.text: So Jacob calls his wives Rachel and Leah, Laban's daughters, out to the field where his flocks are. A family meeting with the whole flock listening in.

cards.question: Out in the field, Jacob tells his wives someone has been with him through all of this. Who?

cards.text: Jacob says he served their father with all his strength, but Laban cheated him and kept changing his wages. That's like your boss rewriting your paycheck every time you turn around.

cards.question: Jacob says Laban changed his wages ___ times.
Jacob says that with all that cheating, Laban was able to harm him.

cards.text: Jacob tells them that if Laban said the speckled ones would be his pay, the whole flock had speckled babies. And if Laban said streaked, the whole flock had streaked babies, like the animals were READING THE CONTRACT.

cards.question: Jacob tells his wives that God has taken away their father's ___ and given them to him.

cards.text: Then Jacob tells them about a dream he had while the flocks were breeding. In the dream, the angel of God called out, "Jacob!" and Jacob answered, "Here I am."

cards.question: In Jacob's dream, the angel tells him to look up at the males mating with the flock. What are they like?

answers.text: All streaked or spotted or speckled
All pure white without a mark
All solid black from head to tail

cards.question: The angel in Jacob's dream says this is happening because something has been seen. What has been seen?

answers.text: All that Laban has done to Jacob
All the gifts Jacob has offered
All the sheep Jacob has lost

cards.text: Then the angel says, "I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to Me." Bethel is where Jacob once poured oil on a stone pillar and made a vow to God (Genesis 28:18-20).

cards.question: In the dream, Jacob is told to wait for Laban's blessing before he leaves.

cards.text: Jacob has told Rachel and Leah everything, dream and all. Now his wives answer, and they start with a question: do they have any share left in their father's house?

cards.question: Rachel and Leah ask, aren't they regarded by their father as ___?
What else do Rachel and Leah say their father did?

answers.text: Sold them and wasted the money

cards.question: Rachel and Leah say the wealth God took from their father belongs to them and their children.
After all that, what do Rachel and Leah tell Jacob to do?

answers.text: Do whatever God has told him
Ask their father for their share
Wait until their brothers calm down

cards.text: Then Jacob gets up, puts his children and wives on camels, and drives all his livestock and everything he gained in Paddan-aram, where he's been living, out ahead of him. Friend, that's not packing up, that's a PARADE.

cards.question: Where is Jacob headed with his whole household?

answers.text: To his father Isaac in Canaan
To his brother Esau in Seir
To the far country of Moab

cards.text: Now, while Laban is out shearing his sheep, somebody takes something that belongs to Laban.

cards.question: While Laban is out shearing, ___ steals Laban's household idols.
Jacob deceives Laban the Aramean. How does Jacob do it?

answers.text: He runs off without telling him
He says he's going to visit Isaac
He says he's only moving the flocks

cards.question: Jacob flees with everything he has and crosses the ___ River.

cards.text: He's headed for the hill country of Gilead. Keep your apron on, friend, because this story is FAR from finished.
